question: Is direction D007 already explored or contradicted: Narrow the benchmark claim to what is unmatched: version-level gold labels (which clause version is authoritative) plus recency-decoupled strata and an answer-differential screen, delivered on amended regulatory text. Do not claim novelty for 'a temporal legal benchmark' or for corpus construction, since legal MCQA with temporal validity, point-in-time financial QA and ESG temporal benchmarks already exist. State explicitly that no directly matching benchmark was found in the searched literature within a budget-limited search, and plan a re-check of the closest legal resource (LEGAL-LINK-EU) to see whether its data can be extended to version-level retrieval, in which case the contribution rests on the measurement and the cross-retriever test rather than on the resource.?
rationale: A refined direction must be checked against existing work before it is recommended.
